project: SP-003 Round 2 (DOC-1-016, continued): deep orthogonal validation of the 468 Round-1 PET-hydrolase candidates
source_topic: DOC-1-016 round 2, assigned by orchestrator via parent 2026-09-21 ~21:33 IST; user mandate: depth over breadth, multi-round 12-human-month projects
question: Which of the 468 Round-1 MGnify PET-hydrolase candidates survive orthogonal domain, catalytic-residue, structure, provenance and false-positive scrutiny, and which 20 form an experimental-ready prioritized shortlist?

grounding_evidence_pre_lock.uniprot_A0A0K8P6T7_features: IsPETase ACT_SITE Ser160 (nucleophile), Asp206, His237 (charge relay); signal peptide 1-27; retrieved live 2026-09-21, SHA recorded in data/raw/grounding/
grounding_evidence_pre_lock.pfam_family: PF12740 (PETase) is the UniProt-recorded Pfam xref for IsPETase; hmmscan-vs-pfam live test on the mature IsPETase sequence returned PF12740.14 as top hit E=4.46e-130, job 02f0db55-c057-4ce5-9d29-9a7f5f8f65a4, 2026-09-21
grounding_evidence_pre_lock.annotation_route: EBI HMMER API hmmscan database=pfam, reachable from sandbox
grounding_evidence_pre_lock.structure_route: RCSB search API (reused from Round 1, confirmed reachable)
grounding_evidence_pre_lock.provenance_route: MGnify study metadata via EBI HMMER /result pages (hit-level studies) and/or MGnify API; must be validated on >= 5 sample MGYP accessions BEFORE bulk retrieval; if unreachable, G5 is reported INCOMPLETE, not relaxed

analysis_plan.R2A_domain: hmmscan vs Pfam-A for all 468 candidates; record all domains with E<=1e-3; domain coherence = PF12740 present as best-E domain
analysis_plan.R2A_triad: global pairwise alignment of each candidate to IsPETase mature sequence; catalytic triad intact iff residues aligned to IsPETase S160/D206/H237 are Ser/Asp/His respectively
analysis_plan.R2A_structure: extend Round-1 RCSB template check (top-50) to the top-150 by Round-1 min E-value; template E<=1e-10, coverage>=60%
analysis_plan.R2B_provenance: resolve each candidate to MGnify study/biome metadata; report biome distribution
R2C_false_positive: redundancy: greedy 90%-identity clustering (kmer prefilter + pairwise confirm); cluster count reported

anti-panel: phmmer of all 468 vs decoy panel of 8 live-verified non-PET esterases/lipases (built live at execution with same retrieval discipline as Round 1); a candidate is flagged if its best anti-panel E is within 10x of its best reference E; flagged candidates are excluded from the shortlist and reported
length sanity: 200-600 aa window on retained candidates (matches characterized PETase mature+signal range)
analysis_plan.R2D_shortlist: composite score over retained candidates: novelty tier (<30/<40%), Round-1 min E, PF12740 coherence, triad intact, RCSB template quality, biome diversity, thermostability proxies (aliphatic index, Cys>=2); exactly 20 with per-candidate rationale cards and full provenance

all_required: G1: pre-execution grounding verified live - IsPETase ACT_SITE (S160/D206/H237) + PF12740 xref retrieved live, hmmscan-vs-pfam route validated end-to-end (met at lock time, evidence in grounding_evidence_pre_lock); provenance route validated on >=5 samples before bulk run
G2: hmmscan annotation succeeds for >= 90% of the 468 candidates (coverage floor; failures enumerated)
G3: >= 60% of annotated candidates have PF12740 as best-E domain (domain coherence)
G4: >= 200 candidates have the intact catalytic triad S-D-H at IsPETase-aligned positions
G5: >= 150 candidates resolve to >= 1 MGnify study/biome; biome distribution reported
G6: redundancy clustering reported; anti-panel flag rate reported and < 20%

G7: shortlist of exactly 20 delivered; every shortlisted candidate has triad intact, PF12740 coherence, not anti-panel flagged, and (RCSB template E<=1e-10 with >=60% coverage OR a documented exception); >= 10 of 20 at <40% identity to every reference

failure_policy: all gates independent and reported; negatives preserved verbatim; no gate text modified after lock; INCOMPLETE != FAIL
leakage_controls: gate locked before any candidate-level Round-2 result is inspected; Round-1 rankings used only for stage ordering, never as evidence
provenance: every live retrieval logged (url, timestamp, sha256) in results/r2_provenance_ledger.jsonl
